Studying at RWTH

Welcome to Aachen, Welcome to RWTH
Explore Academics
Copyright: © Fachgruppe Physik

Using your mobile phone for measurements

RWTH Aachen University has presented its 2025 Teaching Awards. The Special Teaching Award went to the phyphox app, which turns smartphones into versatile tools for physics experiments. Dr. Stefan Lankes received the Teaching Award in the instructor category.

See More

Research at RWTH

A Laboratory of Ideas, a Workshop for Tomorrow
Explore Research
Copyright: © Peter Hinschläger

Next-Generation University: RWTH Retains Excellence Status

The successful evaluation ensures RWTH Aachen University will continue to receive federal and state funding under the Excellence Strategy for the next seven years.

See More

Technology Transfer

From Research to Real-World Solutions
Explore Technology Transfer
Copyright: © Andreas Herrmann

Light Instead of Electricity

That idea is to develop chips that transmit data using light rather than electrical signals. Dr. Daniel Schall and his brother Sebastian are convinced that this technology has the potential to shape the future of computing. Their innovation were recently honored at Aachen City Hall.

See More

Who We Are

International and Interdisciplinary by Design
Explore RWTH
Copyright: © Peter Winandy

RWTH Adopts Integrated Climate Action Plan

RWTH Aachen University has adopted its Integrated Climate Action Plan. The plan provides a realistic and, above all, measurable roadmap for permanently reducing the University’s greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions.

See More

Teaser

Copyright: © Heike Lachmann

Concrete Waste Will Soon be a Thing of the Past. A Brand New Era is Dawning in the Field of Construction

Whether it’s band-aids for bridges filled with sensors or a “hospital” for building components—Concrete is being revolutionized, buildings are being reused, and construction sites are becoming more digital and varied in nature. We spoke with Professor Martin Claßen, director of the Chair and Institute of Structural Concrete, about sustainable construction, smart infrastructure, and why the greatest driver of the construction revolution lies in the material itself.

Read More: Concrete Waste Will Soon be a Thing of the Past. A Brand New Era is Dawning in the Field of Construction

Copyright: © Peter Winandy

Discover, Explore, and Experience Science

On Friday, November 13, the University will once again open its doors for an evening devoted to discovery, experimentation, and science in action. From 6pm to midnight, the C.A.R.L. Lecture Hall Complex and numerous other locations across the University will host RWTH Science Night.

Read More: Discover, Explore, and Experience Science

Excellence

We treat change as a mandate to innovate –  transforming RWTH into a next-generation university that forges new paths in science, industry, and society through excellence, responsibility, and a strong sense of community.

Excellence Strategy

Copyright: © Martin Braun
 

Sustainability

At RWTH, we are committed to advancing sustainability across all areas of the University – by minimizing our environmental impact, working toward climate neutrality, and fostering a culture of responsibility, inclusion, and stewardship.

Sustainability

Copyright: © Jason Moss
 

Diversity

At RWTH, gender equity, equal opportunity, and a deep appreciation for diversity are core values that shape our culture – across research, teaching, learning, careers, and leadership.

Gender and Diversity

Copyright: © Kurt Beyer
 

Internationalization

With more than 15,000 international students, researchers, educators, and staff from over 140 countries, RWTH Aachen University thrives as a hub of international collaboration.

Internationalization
